trigger.condition: MappedDataAdapter.Start receives falsey Conductor before Signal/Graph setup.

likelyCauses.text: MappedDataAdapter.Start receives falsey Conductor before Signal/Graph setup.

diagnostics.expected: Redacted guard/outcome flags identify source stage without SQL text, token, response or provider effect.

correction.boundary: Conditional originating Plan/construction input proposal only; no data/provider effect here.

steps.action: Supply intended nonnull Conductor for mapped Data construction.

stopWhen: Canonical mapped/concrete SQL/ADX identity, activity or exact message/pattern differs.
Effective Plan, registration, transaction/HTTP state or owner cannot be established with redacted flags.
Proposed action would reveal SQL/ADX payload, token, endpoint, response or execute/replay/compensate data/provider effects.

verification.expected: Local guard proposal would satisfy stated predicate; data/provider result unverified.

entries.redaction: Exclude SQL/ADX command/parameter/payload, target/connection/URI, token/credential, response, ItemSignal/Jacket/Plan/graph and exception text; retain canonical adapter/activity, exact message/pattern, correlation-presence and nonsecret guard/outcome flags only.
limitations: A local guard, HTTP response or Signal Result does not establish committed effect, rollback or safe retry.
